      "source": {"file": "relative/path", "function": "...", "anchor": "exact source code excerpt"},

      "guard": {"kind": "missing | incorrect | unsafe_default", "anchor": {"file": "relative/path", "function": "...", "anchor": "missing or insufficient guard context"}},
